'''Bags''' in {{TWMS}} provide additional slots for inventory. They do not replace starting inventory but act as its expansion. The maximum inventory load is determined by the total capacity of bags, since each bag can be purchased only once. Starting inventory holds 200 slots, while its maximum capacity is capped at 1000 slots.
